usage: Use 演奏 to mean performing music on an instrument, or giving a live musical performance.
It is often followed by the instrument or the piece being performed, especially in formal or concert settings.
This word sounds more formal than everyday speech; in casual Cantonese, people may more often say 玩樂器 or 整首歌畀人聽 depending on context.
Common with performance-related words such as 現場、樂團、音樂會, and it fits announcements, program notes, and professional descriptions.
